notes: SparseFock/ (114 files, ~28k lines) moved wholesale and flattened into the leaf Sketching/Sparse/ (the checker forbids subdirectories under a leaf). It is self-contained: outside itself it imports only ForMathlib.Probability.{FiniteLaw,FiniteL2,FiniteProductLaw} and Matrix.InversePowerConcavity; outside importers are only Sketching/{SparseEmbedding,SparseFrameBridge,SparseLaws}.lean and the aggregator. Base names are already unique within the flat leaf apart from one collision (SparseEmbedding) and one misleading name (FiniteHilbert); Lean namespaces NLAlib.SparseFock.* are unchanged so no declaration changes.

Why flatten rather than keep Sparse/SparseFock/: Sparse is a leaf in TREE; keeping the subtree needs a tree change (see flags). Flattening keeps the module names readable since every SparseFock file name is distinctive (Heavy*, Light*, Directional*, Exact*, SparseIID*, UniformExactS*, ...).

Rule used for Sketching: Properties/* hold the property definitions, their deterministic theory and generic implications (JL moment -> AMM); family-specific guarantees go with the family (GaussianEmbedding -> Gaussian, SRHT* -> Structured, CountSketch*/Sparse* -> Sparse, LeverageSampling/SamplingMultiplication* -> Sampling). Exception per brief: JL.lean (Gaussian JL) -> Properties/JL.

IsSubspaceEmbedding definition (Sketching/Basic.lean) goes to Properties/SubspaceEmbedding/Basic.lean beside its equivalent forms (SubspaceEmbedding, Gram, SingularValueEmbedding, FiniteIndexTransport); Sketching/Basic is left empty.

SubGaussianRows (extreme singular values of independent isotropic sub-Gaussian rows, Vershynin 5.39) is a random-matrix model result -> RandomMatrix/SubGaussian; it imports SubGaussianJL, whose content is fixed-vector norm concentration for the same row model (imports only Concentration + Mathlib), so SubGaussianJL moves with it to RandomMatrix/SubGaussian (layer 2).
FiniteSampling (PMF -> probability measure, product laws for i.i.d. draws; Mathlib-only imports; also used by LowRank/ComplexVolumeSamplingLaw) -> Probability/Sampling.
Coordinator: SparseFock kept as the subdirectory Sketching/Sparse/SparseFock (the checker now allows it); CountSketch*/Sparse* stay directly in Sketching/Sparse.
flags: PROPOSAL (tree): make Sketching/Sparse a non-leaf, e.g. Sketching/Sparse/{Basic,CountSketch,SparseStack} with SparseStack holding the 114 former SparseFock files (or add a sibling leaf Sketching/SparseFock). Meanwhile mapped flat into Sketching/Sparse (123 files).
